primary_variables.matched_definition: Comparison defined by patterned substrates, confinement, geometry, topography, or spatial constraints.
evidence: A proteomic analysis of transwell-migrated neutrophils identified alterations in proteins
The transmigration assay was performed on healthy control neutrophils allowed to incubate in or migrate towards synovial fluid

In this experiment neutrophil proteomes were investigated after migration towards JIA synovial fluid in an in vitro model of a synovial membrane, compared to neutrophils incubated in synovial fluid without migration.

attributes.route_or_context: transwell inserts with endothelial cells and synoviocytes
evidence: Inserts were placed in an ultra-low attachment 24-well cell culture plate in with 400 μl MCDB 131 media with 10% synovial fluid.
Healthy donor neutrophils, 5x105 in 100 μl MCDB 131, were added to the transwell inserts and incubated for 1 h at 37°C.

replicate_hints: All conditions were performed in triplicates.

evidence: Proteins were considered significantly altered if the average abundance in migrated compared to incubated neutrophils had an absolute Log2 fold change of >0.585

quantification_strategy: normalized against total amount of peptides per sample

base_candidates_ranked.reason: The experiment used positive data-dependent acquisition (DDA) on an Orbitrap Fusion and normalized protein abundances against the total amount of peptides per sample, which is a characteristic of label-free quantification (LFQ).
